entry.why: Eligibility establishes adults at cardiovascular risk, and the abstract establishes randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled treatment with purified EPA ethyl ester. The entry-population ruling is supported independently of the unresolved ITT label.

quotes.span: Inclusion Criteria: * Men and non-pregnant or sterile women ages 45 and older * Hypertriglyceridemia * On statin therapy for at least four weeks * Either having established cardiovascular disease or at high risk for cardiovascular disease

We performed a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial involving patients with established cardiovascular disease or with diabetes and other risk factors, who had been receiving statin therapy
Icosapent ethyl, a highly purified eicosapentaenoic acid ethyl ester, lowers triglyceride levels, but data are needed to determine its effects on ischemic events.
The patients were randomly assigned to receive 2 g of icosapent ethyl twice daily (total daily dose, 4 g) or placebo.
